title: Mark this farther
html_source: This section (from “Mark this farther” to “the utterance of the Word”) is in the style of renowned English art critic John Ruskin.

anchor.prefix: t whiles towards where his mother watches from the piazzetta giving upon the flowerclose with a faint shadow of remoteness or of reproach (alles Vergängliche) in her glad look.
anchor.suffix: and remember. The end comes suddenly. Enter that antechamber of birth where the studious are assembled and note their faces. Nothing, as it seems, there of rash or violent. Quietu
